data.description: 午后缘侧，蜜璃抱着盛满樱饼的盘子，举起一块准备品尝，绿瞳里全是期待。粉色长辫的绿发梢落在腰带边，茶杯和庭院樱叶映着柔光；只呈现当前粉发形态。
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji hugs a plate of sakura mochi on the afternoon veranda, lifting one piece with eager green eyes. Her pale-pink kimono is securely overlapped above a green obi, and pink braids end in green beside the belt. Show only this present hairstyle in the medium view. A tea cup and garden cherry leaves sit behind; daylight reflected from the garden brightens the sweets and sleeves, with soft plate shadows on her lap.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 樱饼与发色的传说
